name: AppUi::DataTable
description: A slim list table: a header per column descriptor, a row per record, an optional check button per row and a row actions cell. Sorting and selection are reported out.

rows.description: The records, one row each; each needs an id

sort.description: The active sort key; its column shows the order

selectable.description: Adds a check button per row and a select-all button in the header

selection.description: A Selection (utils/state/selection) shared with the toolbar; the row check buttons and the select-all button (rows shown) toggle through it and it is kept across pages. Replaces selectedIds, onSelect and onSelectAll

selectedIds.description: The ids of the selected rows, kept by the owner so the selection survives paging; makes the row check buttons controlled (when selection is not given)

groupKey.description: (record) => the group key of a record; groups the rows under collapsible headings

depthKey.description: Tree rows: the record field holding the row's level (1 = top); indents the first column

isExpandable.description: Tree rows: (record) => whether the row shows a caret button

expandedIds.description: Tree rows: the ids of the open rows, kept by the owner

loadingIds.description: Tree rows: the ids of the rows loading their next level, kept by the owner; they show a spinner in place of the caret

currentId.description: Tree rows: the id of the pinned current row (class data-table-row--current, no caret, no row actions)

hasMoreActions.description: (record) => whether the row shows the moreActions menu; without it every row does

payload.name: checked
payload.description: Whether they should all be selected

onSelectAll.description: The select-all box was toggled (with selectable, without selection)

payload.name: sortKey
payload.description: The sort key of the column clicked

onSort.description: The sort button of a sortable column was clicked

payload.name: id
payload.description: The id of the row's record

payload.name: checked
payload.description: Whether the row is now selected

onSelect.description: A row check button was toggled (with selectable, without selection)

payload.name: ids
payload.description: The selected ids, as strings, across pages

onSelectionChange.description: A row box or the select-all box changed the shared selection (with selectable and selection)

onToggle.description: The caret of a tree row was clicked; the owner loads or removes the next level

cell.description: Draws the cells of the columns without a cell component

rowActions.description: The last cell of every row: the row's buttons, with AccessControl inside

moreActions.description: Extra row actions, shown in a dropdown opened by a menu button

groupHeading.description: Replaces the label of a group heading (with groupKey)

yields.name: group
yields.description: The group: key, label, items, count

empty.description: Shown across the table when there are no rows

key.description: The column's name; also the record field shown when nothing else draws the cell

sortKey.description: The key reported by onSort; defaults to key

cell.description: A component that draws the cell, called with @record and @column

subKey.description: The record field shown as a muted second line under the cell

class.description: The class of the column's cells

id.description: Identifies the row for the selection

variants.name: list page
variants.description: Sorting, selection, hand-built cells and row actions

variants.name: shared selection
variants.description: Selection kept across pages and shared with the toolbar

variants.name: tree
variants.description: Flattened tree rows that load their next level on demand, grouped in place, with a pinned current row
